in_sanskrit.name: अर्जरज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is valiant, brave, and victorious. Arjraj is a compound word from 'arj' meaning 'valiant, brave' and 'raj' meaning 'ruler, king, victorious'.

in_hindi.name: अर्जरज
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is more valiant than others, a victor over enemies.

in_tamil.name: அர்ஜ்ராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A mighty warrior, a noble and valiant person.

in_telugu.name: అర్జ్రాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: A mighty and powerful warrior, a brave and courageous person.

in_marathi.name: Arjraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the name Arjuna, meaning 'bright, radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna was a great warrior and one of the five Pandava brothers. This name symbolizes courage, strength, and wisdom.

in_bengali.name: Arjraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Arjuna's radiance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Arjraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the name Arjuna, meaning 'bright, radiant'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna was a great warrior and one of the five Pandava brothers. This name symbolizes courage, strength, and wisdom.
